title: Redis Commands Cheat sheet - Website wrong examples for "Sets", "Lists", "Streams" in "cli" section
body:
Redis Commands Cheat sheet - Website wrong examples for "Sets", "Lists", "Streams" in "cli" section

Sets section in cli is having examples of Streams
Streams section in cli is having examples of Lists

link - https://redis.io/learn/howtos/quick-start/cheat-sheet#sorted-sets
